name: North Canal Flood — SIH Demo Scenario
description: Simulated flood event affecting the virtual city's North Canal region. Demonstrates ResQnet end-to-end response workflow from initial warning through responder dispatch and hub capacity management.

historical_context.note: HISTORICAL CONTEXT ONLY — NOT A LIVE PREDICTION
historical_context.disclaimer: Historical data is provided as scenario background only. This engine does not claim predictive accuracy.

events.title: T+00 | Event 1/7
events.description: [SIM | SIMULATED OFFICIAL] FLOOD WARNING — North Canal region. Residents in North Market area should prepare for evacuation. Proceed to Hub Alpha or Hub Beta.

api_payload.title: [SIM] FLOOD WARNING — North Canal Region
api_payload.message: [SIMULATED OFFICIAL ALERT] Rising water levels detected in North Canal region. Residents are advised to evacuate to Hub Alpha (Community Center) or Hub Beta (Government School). This is a simulated demonstration event.

events.chain_notes: Calls real alerts service → creates EmergencyAlert → recorded in AuditLog → visible on dashboard via /api/v1/alerts/active

events.title: T+10 | Event 2/7
events.description: [SIM | SIMULATED SENSOR] Water level sensor reports danger threshold reached at River Basin.
events.chain_notes: Activates HazardZone ID 1 (River Basin Flood Zone). is_active=True, severity=HIGH. The routing engine reads active hazard zones via PostGIS ST_Intersects on next route calculation — roads intersecting this zone will get spatial penalties. This is a hazard activation observation, NOT a claim that a sensor directly triggers verified ground truth.
events.chain_warning: IMPORTANT: This activates a hazard zone as an observation signal. The routing graph is lazily rebuilt on next /routing/calculate call via the dirty-cache mechanism. No routing result is fabricated.

events.title: T+20 | Event 3/7
events.description: [SIM | SIMULATED CITIZEN] Citizen reports flooding and road obstruction near Central West intersection.

api_payload.description: [SIM | SIMULATED CITIZEN] Flooding and road obstruction near Central West. Water is knee-deep. Residents need assistance.

events.chain_notes: Calls find_or_create_cluster() then creates IncidentReport objects with status=UNVERIFIED. Reports enter the cluster pipeline at Tier-1 (unverified). They do NOT become verified ground truth — they are citizen signals pending responder verification. Clustering and mission dispatch must occur through the normal coordination workflow.
events.chain_warning: Reports are created with status=UNVERIFIED. Simulation does not skip ground-truth verification. The cluster will become visible to coordinators for dispatch decision.

events.title: T+30 | Event 4/7
events.description: [SIM | SIMULATED RESPONDER] Responder reports Flood-Prone River Road (ID 12) is blocked by floodwater.
events.chain_notes: Sets road.is_blocked=True, road.status=BLOCKED on Road ID 12 (Flood-Prone River Road). This represents an authoritative operational update (coordinator acting on responder observation). The routing engine excludes blocked roads from graph edges on next calculation — this is REAL routing behavior, not a UI animation. The routing cache is invalidated automatically.
events.chain_warning: This bypasses the field-survey ground-truth flow (FieldSurvey + verification_outcome). This is documented as a simulation shortcut: the coordinator is directly applying the observation. In production, a responder would submit a FieldSurvey. This gap is explicitly noted in the event log.

events.title: T+40 | Event 5/7
events.description: [SIM | SIMULATED COORDINATOR] Coordinator dispatches Responder 1 (Team Alpha) to verify cluster and assist affected residents.

api_payload_template.title: [SIM] Verify North Canal Flood Cluster — FLOOD_DEMO_01
api_payload_template.description: [SIMULATED COORDINATOR DISPATCH] Team Alpha dispatched to verify citizen flood reports near Central West. Assess road conditions and assist evacuation.
api_payload_template.notes: Simulation scenario FLOOD_DEMO_01 — T+40 dispatch event

events.chain_notes: Calls /api/v1/missions which invokes create_mission_service(). This: (1) validates cluster exists, (2) validates responder eligibility (available, not offline), (3) creates Mission in ASSIGNED state, (4) updates cluster.status to mission_assigned, (5) emits MISSION_CREATED AuditLog. Exactly ONE mission is created — /api/simulation/events/dispatch is NOT also called (would duplicate). The responder must still accept/start through their own flow for full lifecycle.
events.chain_warning: Responder_id resolved dynamically from /api/v1/missions/responders before dispatch. Cluster_id resolved from simulation state after E003. If responder is already on_mission from a previous run, reset is required first.

events.title: T+50 | Event 6/7
events.description: [SIM | SIMULATED SHELTER SENSOR] Hub Alpha reports significant occupancy increase as evacuees arrive.
events.chain_notes: Calls /api/v1/hubs/{id}/occupancy which invokes update_occupancy_service(). This: (1) acquires SELECT FOR UPDATE row lock, (2) validates new occupancy does not exceed max_capacity, (3) calls derive_hub_status() to derive new status from occupancy ratio vs capacity_critical_threshold (0.85), (4) emits SAFETY_HUB_OCCUPANCY_UPDATED AuditLog, (5) commits. Hub Alpha starts at 120 occupancy (max 400). After delta=+180, occupancy=300, ratio=0.75 — status remains OPEN (below 0.85 threshold). Dashboard reflects real hub state.
events.chain_warning: NONE — this goes through full business logic including row locking, status derivation, and audit logging.

events.title: T+60 | Event 7/7
events.description: [SIM | SIMULATION ENGINE] Situation update: Flood scenario has fully propagated. Road 12 blocked, Hub Alpha at increased occupancy, responder dispatched. Review operational state.

api_payload.title: [SIM] SITUATION UPDATE — North Canal Flood T+60
api_payload.message: [SIMULATED SITUATION REPORT] Flood scenario update: River Basin Hazard Zone activated, Flood-Prone River Road blocked, evacuation in progress to Hub Alpha (occupancy elevated), NGO Team Alpha dispatched for verification. All events are part of FLOOD_DEMO_01 simulation.

events.chain_notes: Creates second EmergencyAlert via real alerts service. Coordinator can see both the original FLOOD_WARNING and the SITUATION_UPDATE on the dashboard. Both recorded in AuditLog.
